entries.notes: 3X-UI 3.8.5 live adapter verification (2026-09-16 UTC) used PSP main at 2440112 against upstream tag 7ef22f94 and Xray 26.9.9 on darwin/arm64. TestLive_XUISurface, TestLive_XUIConnectionLimits and TestLive_XUIRealityScan passed. The release carries the negative-subSortIndex preservation and the 26.9.8+ REALITY ML-KEM subscription handling that verification exercised. THIS ENTRY REPLACES THREE. They were keyed by the PSP beta line - beta.9 and up on 3.8.5, beta.1 through beta.8 on 3.7.0 - and the legacy scheme is gone, so a build of that line is not an identity anything can be matched against. The 3.7.0 ceiling recorded for the early betas belonged to builds that no longer have a name. Keep a narrower entry ahead of this baseline if a later release changes the contract.

sui_entries.notes: S-UI 1.6.3 live adapter verification (2026-09-16 UTC) used PSP main at 2440112 against upstream tag 13abbdc4 and sing-box 1.14.1 on darwin/arm64. TestLive_SUISurface passed after upgrading the 1.6.2 scratch database. Token authentication and inbound/client read-write shapes remain compatible; the new session API and multi-user Snell support are additive. No S-UI minimum or new optional capability is claimed.
